extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 2 test build: browsing, metadata and Trakt (playback arrives in stage 4).
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 0.2.4: Trending and Popular lists, and big lists, now open quickly: they load a page at a time with a Next page item. Adding to or removing from a list shows straight away. 0.2.3: Upcoming and Recent episodes start each line with when it airs or aired, in your time zone (Today 21:00, Tomorrow 02:00, Sat 14 Nov 20:00). 0.2.2: In Next up, Upcoming episodes and Recent episodes the show name now uses your Highlight colour ("No highlight" keeps it plain). 0.2.1: Fixed watched episodes not downloading from Trakt (Trakt now sends seasons only when asked), which left Next up and Shows in progress empty. Your watch history downloads again in full on the next sync. Next up now says why when it's empty. 0.2.0: Trakt. Sign in with a code on trakt.tv; My films, My TV shows with Next up, shows in progress, upcoming and recent episodes, recommendations and Trakt lists; watched marks, resume points and season progress; Trakt actions on every title (watched, collection, watchlist, favourites, lists, rate, hide, clear resume point); background sync of only what changed; Trakt sync in Tools. 0.1.4: Advanced artwork sizes now sit directly under Artwork quality, with no empty heading left behind. 0.1.3: One search for films, TV shows and people; actors' and directors' pages; related titles and cast (context menu); TV networks, new shows and streaming services; sortable lists; hide options per menu; customisable home menu; episode title styles; highlight colour; Advanced artwork sizes; API keys checked when entered; grouped Tools with Clear all caches. 0.1.2: Fixed search, genres and years. 0.1.1: The setup wizard asks for your own TMDB key. 0.1.0: First Stage 1 test build.

extension.description: Installs and keeps up to date the add-ons published by MrSpongeHead.
